annotations.text:
Quiet home · the approved direction

Home: clock, then at most two lines — Next (the one time-bound thing) and Reach (only people or groups on your reach list) — then a short word list of tools. Usually just the clock and the words.
Later: pull up from the bottom. The full record across every source; swipe to open / later / done / mute; low-priority folded into a digest.
Person: verbs, then one scroll of everything between you across every app; time scrubber at the bottom.
Type: pull down anywhere; one line resolves to verbs; cleared, it is every app, no icons.

Chrome is never colored. Photos and links are.
Earlier directions, superseded by the proposal. Kept for reference: B · Ink (true-black tiles) and C · Ledger (mono list). A · Paper was rebuilt into the quiet home.
